tasks.title: require_provisioner helper
tasks.detail: Copy fke-server require_admin shape (admin.rs:19-49): extract bearer -> rls_from_bearer -> role check vs "service_role". Error bodies per FFS-001 §4.1. Lives in routes/schema/mod.rs or a shared auth module.

tasks.title: routes/schema module split + plan handler
tasks.detail: routes/schema/{mod,plan,apply,status}.rs. plan.rs: typed deserialize -> validate -> introspect -> generate -> persist_planned (D-P1 upsert by hash) -> §4.2 response. Warnings include acknowledged-unscoped.

tasks.title: apply handler with drift guard + sub attribution
tasks.detail: load_planned: 404/410; re-plan + hash compare: 409; provisioner.apply(applied_by = ctx JWT sub — never raw_bearer); alreadyApplied via ledger conflict; 500 + failed row SQLSTATE-only; restartRequired:true + restartNote verbatim-ish FFS-001 §4.3.

tasks.title: status handler
tasks.detail: enabled = allowlist non-empty; namespaces = parsed allowlist; schemaVersion = state_manager.current() version; lastApply = latest applied|failed ledger row or null. No user-schema access.

tasks.title: Always-mount + in-handler 503 gate + bootstrap merge
tasks.detail: Mount /schema/v1 group unconditionally in bootstrap.rs (MCP-group idiom .route×n -> .with_state -> .merge). Handlers return 503 when FLINT_PROVISION_NAMESPACES empty/unset. Gateway builds PgProvisioner only when enabled; state carries Option<> and handlers 503 on None.

tasks.title: OpenAPI docs for the group
tasks.detail: Document the 5 operations (plan/apply/status here; ddl arrives in c005) in the gateway's OpenAPI surface, matching existing hand-written route documentation conventions.
